name: Jahid Hasan Rony
title: Lecturer, Researcher
subtitle: AI Research Aficionado
bio:
I am a postgraduate researcher in Computer Science and Engineering, interested in understanding how AI can understand visual information more efficiently.

My research focuses on deep learning and image processing; more into semantic segmentation, with a particular interest in lightweight model design. I completed my B.Sc. (2023) and M.Sc. (2026) from DUET, Bangladesh, where my master’s thesis explored efficient segmentation models for image analysis (Link to my Paper Published in Nature).

From 2023 to 2026, I worked as a Research Assistant at Independent University, Bangladesh, contributing to projects in medical imaging, UAV-based image analysis, and deep learning-based segmentation. These experiences helped me develop as a researcher and led to journal and conference publications, including Q1 journals and A-ranked venues.

I also enjoy teaching and explaining technical ideas in a simple way. At present, I am actively looking for PhD opportunities where I can continue learning, contribute to meaningful research, and grow as an independent researcher.
